senses.en: belonging to or connected with people or things already mentioned

example.en: The students put their books on the desks.
example.zh: 学生们把他们的书放在课桌上。

senses.en: used to refer to a singular person whose gender is not specified
senses.zh: （指性别不详的单数人）其；他们的

example.en: Each child should bring their own lunch.
example.zh: 每个孩子都应自带午餐。

senses.en: an arranged meeting at a particular time and place

example.en: I have a dentist appointment at three.
example.zh: 我三点钟有个牙医预约。

example.en: She accepted an appointment as head of the department.
example.zh: 她接受了系主任的职位。

senses.en: the act of choosing someone for a position or job

example.en: The committee approved the appointment of a new director.
example.zh: 委员会批准了对新主任的任命。
